name: Marcus & Millichap, Inc.
summary: Marcus & Millichap, Inc., an investment brokerage company, provides commercial real estate investment sales, financing services, research and advisory services in the United States and Canada. The company offers research on various property types comprising multifamily, retail, office, industrial, single-tenant net lease, seniors housing, self-storage, hospitality, medical office, and manufactured housing, as well as capital markets/financing.
